surface: Testing infrastructure resource admission and watchdog
title: External-drive resource checks miss internal disk exhaustion and safety-marker failure
reproduction: Observe the October 2 D54 native run with repository and owned browser profile on the external Samsung drive, which has about 1.7 TiB free.
The internal macOS Data volume falls to about 116 MiB free while admission and watchdog samples only measure repository/profile volumes.
The watchdog cannot write its unsafe-hold marker under /var/tmp because of ENOSPC; the run ends invalid. A separate shell tempfile and new agent writer-lock creation also fail with ENOSPC.
expected: Admission refuses work when any required system or safety-state volume is below the configured minimum. Watchdog safety-state persistence failure cannot leave a live workload treated as safe or release its ownership prematurely.
actual: External repository/profile free space hid internal disk exhaustion. The D54 run completed UI assertions but final safety-state persistence failed, invalidating acceptance; shell and agent initialization also failed.
severity: S1: unsafe test environment can invalidate results and prevent safety-state persistence
priority: P0: recover storage and repair admission before another test launch
